text:
Incident Bot: ALERT: Scheduled handoff in ~20m for night region. Secondary coverage missing (Samira OOO). Flagging a potential coverage gap — primary (Alex P) ends 07:00 UTC. Follow escalation matrix in /handbook/oncall. Please reply with coverage plan or ask for escalation now.

Alex P: I’m primary until 07:00 UTC. Heads-up I might not be able to stay full extra shift — flight delay risk. If I can't extend, please prepare to escalate.

Samira: OOO today, sorry — can’t cover. @Maria G can you pick up secondary for the start of the night?

Maria G: I can cover secondary for the first ~2h, then Jordan can take over if needed. Quick Q: what threshold do we want to page SRE for 5xx spikes?

Jordan: For prod: sev1 -> page primary immediately (phone/pager), sev2 -> page primary + secondary (chat + pager) if >5% 5xx over 5m or >3 customers affected. For single-customer regressions page the customer owner + secondary first.

Lee T: Clarifying escalation timeline: sev1 ack window = 5m; if no ack -> page oncall lead (ops-lead). If still no response in 15m escalate to SRE manager and exec oncall. Include pager escalation policy in notes.

Alex P: Noted. Runbook link here: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/api-5xx — follow the ‘region failover’ section if error rate stays high. Steps: collect traces, check autoscaler, tail model pods, execute region shift if necessary.

PagerDuty: Incident created PD-12345 for “api 5xx spike”. Reminder: use the ACK button to suppress repeated alerts. If you manually open a new incident, include PD id.

Maria G: I’m initiating a temporary routing change to reduce load on eu-west-1 (will shift small % to eu-central). Doing change now — change id r-998. I’ll post confirmation when the error rate drops.

Incident Bot: Routing change initiated by Maria G — change id r-998. Monitoring metrics: error-rate, p50/p95 latency.

Jordan: I can take the warm handoff at 07:30 UTC (or earlier if Alex needs to leave). If there’s any customer data loss, escalate immediately to legal + CSM and mark the incident sev1.

Alex P: Flight pushed, I can extend +30m and stay until 07:30 UTC. I’ll remain primary until Jordan confirms takeover. Leaving a short checklist in #incidents-log.

Samira: Thanks — @PagerDuty please ensure oncall lead is paged if errors persist >20m after mitigation steps. Also flag any outage communications if customer-visible.

Lee T: Quick mapping reminder for docs: sev1 = outage (page all: primary, secondary, ops-lead, SRE manager), sev2 = degraded (page primary + secondary), sev3 = advisory (chat only + monitoring). Put these in the handoff note.

Jordan: Got it. I’ll run through the runbook start-to-finish during the handoff and begin canary traffic shift once error rate is stable for 3 consecutive minutes.

Alex P: ack. Leaving handoff notes: customer-impact = multi-tenant; mitigation applied = partial region failover; contacts updated in incident notes.

Incident Bot: Thread pinned to channel for handoff. Last update 2215004578.
